tool_input.description: Show exp 12 metrics and aborted exp13 design

tool_input.command: ls -la model/pretrained/ ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/ 2>&1; cat runs/20261101_170039_experiment12/experiment.json | head -c 200; echo; grep -n "pretrained\|bake" runs/20261101_170039_experiment12/experiment.json | head -20

result:
The design for experiment 13 is in `runs/pending_experiment.json`. The file parses and has every required field, including the implementation brief. It hasn't been trained yet; the harness does that next.

**Where things stand.** Experiment 12 is the best so far at **0.560** on the held-out 2024 photograph: 49.5% usable fixes, 5.5% false fixes, and 45% of frames abstaining. When it does answer, it is right about 90% of the time. Almost all the remaining loss is abstention: the model doesn't recognise the place in the new photograph often enough. On the three training photographs it scores 96–98% usable from the same held-out viewpoints, so the gap comes from the photograph, not the viewpoint. Training accuracy was also still rising when the 8 epochs ended.

**The experiment: deeper pretrained trunk** (category: architecture).
- **Why:** the only thing that lifted the 2024 photograph out of the 6–14% usable band was swapping in the ImageNet-pretrained trunk (experiment 12: 10.75% → 49.5% usable). But that trunk was cut at its shallowest useful point, the edge-and-texture layers. Those are the layers that react most to changes in exposure, season and shadow between surveys.
- **The change:** each committee member now runs MobileNetV3-Small one level deeper, through `features[0..10]` (a 96-channel 4×4 map), and its place description combines that deeper level with the current 48-channel 8×8 level. Both levels are reduced to 56 numbers each, so the description stays at 112 numbers and nothing downstream changes.
- **Weights:** they are already in the repo as `model/pretrained/mnv3s_features10.pt`, so nothing is downloaded. I loaded the file: it fits the network exactly, gives a 96×4×4 output, and its first nine blocks are identical to the trunk experiment 12 used.
- **Different from experiment 5:** that run added from-scratch layers to see the whole frame and lost its fit on the training photographs. Here the deeper blocks come pretrained and are only fine-tuned slowly.
- **Prediction:** about 57% usable (range 52–63%), false fixes still around 4–7%, mission score about 0.48. Expected model size is about 7–8 MB, well under the 32 MiB limit.
- **Refuted if:** 2024 usable stays at or below 50%, or false fixes go above about 8%. That would mean trunk depth isn't the bottleneck, and the next experiment should target the gap between photographs through the training signal or the decode instead.

The change is confined to `model/model.py` (the trunk and how its levels are combined) plus log and info strings in `model/train.py`. The brief restates the training command, the ONNX export format, the deployment limits, and the rule that nothing under `model/` may read the 2024 photograph.
